title: Updating the Row Counter
statement: Let $\sigma$ be a nine-register state and let $z\in\mathbb{N}$. Replacing coordinate $2$ of its register vector by $z$ gives the register vector of the state obtained by replacing its row-counter register by $z$.
replaced:
Let a register state be the 9-tuple $(p,n,a,b,s,t,tmp,st,nx)$ of natural numbers, and
let its register vector list these entries in order at indices $0$ through $8$.
Replacing entry $2$ of this vector by any $z\in\mathbb{N}$ gives the register vector of
the state obtained by replacing $a$ by $z$.
